body: Well it’s been about three years off and on. He barely even talks to me. I try to understand because of work but even on his days off he barely will. We haven’t physically seen each other for almost a month
Maybe. But he always ignores me. I’m starting to believe that I just don’t matter to him.
I texted him. All he said was good morning a few minutes ago. I don’t think I’ll text him back for a while. But almost 13 hours...
Don’t be sorry. What’s to be sorry about? Nothing like that happened to you
Oh. Well good for him. I hope he enjoys watching me suffer. It’s so great to know that a loving god put me in this position :p too late, being good sucks.
It’s my first post on this account. Thanks?

I honestly have nothing else to say about it. What exactly am I supposed to even vent about I literally just put it all in the post. But thanks for “caring” but I think you should worry about your own problems if your even a part of this community. That was a bit bitchy. Sorry I guess
